overview.description: The AAM Crescent CLO ETF (CLOC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed, investing primarily in investment-grade collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), denominated in US dollars. The fund aims for capital preservation, current income, and low correlation to traditional asset classes. CLOC was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by Advisors Asset Management.
